limits.usage_stop_semantics: Check actual cumulative usage after every completed exchange; at or above threshold send no further trial. A single in-flight completion may cross the threshold. quality_gate.interpretation: Gates apply per complete assembled case/repetition. A missing, invalid or rejected child fails that trial; no partial credit for correct siblings. The three previous fresh cases are now known regressions, not unused qualification.
